articles.title: Hackers Infect 17,960 Android Phones With Banking Trojans, Steal 7.6 Million SMS Messages
articles.summary:

The operation combines fake bank calls, phishing websites, malicious applications, and cryptocurrency mining to steal financial information while quietly exploiting infected phones.
